Farah Moreno
farah.moreno@example.com | Sacramento, CA
Farah Moreno has 13 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Meridian Cloud (2022-2026), where
they owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 53M events/day. Before that,
Staff Backend Engineer at Driftwood Solutions (2018-2022). Before that, Senior
Backend Engineer at Vertex Infrastructure (2013-2018). Education: Ph.D.
Electrical Engineering, Portland State University, 2013; B.S. Electrical
Engineering, Indiana University, 2006. Core skills: Node.js, CI/CD, PostgreSQL,
Redis, REST API design, AWS, Distributed systems, TypeScript.
